scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@enterprise-d/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@enterprise-d/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@enterprise-d/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@enterprise-d/rules
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:failure-regression && npm run build
